international.title: Man accused of sparking deadly Los Angeles wildfire found guilty
international.summary: Verdict in case against former Uber driver Jonathan Rinderknecht comes after first trial ended with hung jury The 30-year-old accused of sparking the deadly Palisades fire in Los Angeles was found guilty of two federal arson charges in a Friday verdict that came months after his first trial concluded with a hung jury.
